_: Lane A P1. Every module that is built and held in reserve, behind a flag, defaulting off. Turning one on in Round 2 is flipping `on` to true here. `play_when` is the ask that should make you reach for it.
_how: Flags are read at module load. Flip `on` here and the page picks it up on the next reload — that is the whole ceremony. The Evidence tab lists what is held and what it costs to turn on, so the reserve is visible to the jury without being live.
